title: The Erdős Unit Distance Problem (Disproved 2026)
statement_plain: What is the maximum number of unit distances among n points in the plane? Erdős's n^(1+o(1)) conjecture was disproved in May 2026 via infinite class field towers (arXiv:2605.20695), yielding >= n^(1+delta) unit distances; determining the sharp extremal exponent in (1+delta, 4/3] remains open.
